description: Expected-value engine. Compute expected values over discrete, continuous, simulated, or tree-structured uncertainty, plus football-field ranges. Use this for generic probability weighting of scenarios, Monte-Carlo and decision trees; it does NOT perform IFRS/HKFRS measurement of provisions, insurance or employee-benefit obligations (use calculate_actuarial_pv), and it does not price path-dependent payoffs (use calculate_structured_product). Methods: discrete: outcomes, probabilities; continuous: distribution, mean, std, lower, upper; scenario: scenarios; monte_carlo: iterations, distributions, base_params, seed; decision_tree: tree; football_field: estimates. Supply exactly one method with its declared inputs (no defaults). An unknown method, a missing input, or an extra field returns an error envelope (code INVALID_ARGUMENT) instead of raising.

estimates.description: Estimates [{method, central, low, high}] for a football field.

method.description: Formula to apply; the tool description lists the exact inputs each value requires.

probabilities.description: Cumulative success probability per period in [0,1], aligned with cash_flows.

scenarios.description: Scenarios [{probability, value}] with probabilities summing to 1.

seed.description: Deterministic RNG seed (required by simulation methods for reproducibility).

name: calculate_expected_value

outputSchema.description: Shared result envelope returned by every tool.

assumptions.description: Inputs and assumptions used, echoed for traceability.

data_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the underlying data, when fetched.

error.description: Error detail, present only when status='error'.

formula_ref.description: Formula or standards reference for the method.

method.description: Method or tool name that produced the result.

steps.description: Ordered computation steps, when the method reports them.

ticker.description: Ticker the result pertains to, when applicable.

title: Expected value and probability weighting
